expectations.text: Analyzes current drawing tool selection UX in lib/main.dart
expectations.evidence: Identifies nested select menu and multi-tap friction for doctors switching tools.

expectations.text: Proposes a stylus-friendly design pattern (e.g. radial menu or docked toolbelt)
expectations.evidence: Proposes a Floating Radial (Pie) Menu overlay (Option A) and a Floating Tool-Belt pill (Option B).

expectations.text: Outlines specific UX interaction rules (e.g. tap-to-select, long-press to open radial)
expectations.evidence: Specifies long-press gesture triggers overlay, dragging selects tool, and releasing closes/selects.

expectations.text: Provides developer tasks to implement the menu and hook it to BLoC
expectations.evidence: Provides tasks including radial menu widget creation, canvas gesture integration, and DrawBloc event bindings.
